entities.name: Ante Toni Žižić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ante Toni Žižić is a Croatian professional basketball player for Beşiktaş Gain of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroCup. He was selected 23rd overall by the Boston Celtics in the 2016 NBA draft. He played in the NBA Finals as a member of the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2018.
